import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { Then, When } from '@cucumber/cucumber';

When('I run the Claude-only setup scenario', function () {
  this.result = {
    stdout: 'Claude installed',
    inspectedAgents: process.env.BDD_CORPUS_DEFECT === '1' ? ['claude', 'codex'] : ['claude'],
  };
});
Then('only Claude state influences the result', function () {
  assert.match(this.result.stdout, /Claude/);
});
